decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a multi-model line close to the core offer that fits the announced design-led direction, and as a product only mentioned on the website, its short time on the market lets any weak results be blamed on temporary causes.

The shower channel for seamless coverings has its own page, which is a visible commitment, and it is central to the announced barrier-free bathroom strategy, so dropping it would expose the launch decision as a mistake.
The pump-assisted line needed real development investment as an extension of the core offer, so management would persist with it and attribute slow uptake to the market still building.
The tileable floor drain sits close to the core range and is presented on its own page, so the public commitment and low running cost favour keeping it.
The stainless design grate supports the firm's design-and-engineering identity and is publicly presented on its own page, and little is gained by withdrawing it this soon.
